svg.title: How an Agent Works
svg.desc: An agent is given a goal: process all new contracts. It plans by breaking the goal into steps. Step 1: retrieve the contract from SharePoint. Step 2: extract key terms. Step 3: flag non-standard clauses. Step 4: update the tracking spreadsheet. Output: a summary report sent to legal.
svg.text: Give it a goal; it plans the steps and executes them without a prompt at each step.
Agent breaks the goal into steps
